proved_derived_lemmas.rationale: The rule is the reusable form of the exact loop-invariant reachability claim in loop-lemma-spec.k; prove.sh first proves that claim against VERIFICATION-CORE, which does not contain the rule, and only afterward compiles VERIFICATION with this derived rule for the final proof.
proved_derived_lemmas.text:
rule <k> loop("value", IS, searchLoopBody)
            ~> exec(Return(Name("answer")) .Stmts) => .K </k>
       <program> searchProgram </program>
       <input> VList(L) </input>
       <env> ("answer" |-> VInt(A)
              "lst" |-> VList(L)
              "value" |-> VInt(_PREV)) => .Map </env>
       <result> noResult => VInt(scan(L, IS, A)) </result>
       [priority(40)]
